s.how: Fry 16 frozen vegetable spring rolls at 180C for 4 minutes until golden. Drain and serve with sweet chilli sauce. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

s.note: the alien cult and the space cadets
s.how: Pop 100g popcorn kernels. Melt 100g white chocolate, split into bowls with a drop of colouring each and drizzle over the popcorn. Set and break up.

m.note: the drive-thru that keeps saying and then
m.how: Crumb 600g chicken strips in cornflour and fry, then toss in 150ml lemon sauce. Stir-fry 400g sliced beef with 1 head broccoli, 3 tbsp oyster sauce and garlic. Fry 300g cooked rice with 2 eggs, peas and soy.

w.how: Whisk 2 egg whites, 80g sugar, 50g melted butter, 60g flour and vanilla. Spread thin circles on a lined tray, bake at 180C for 6 minutes, then quickly fold each around a paper message.

d.how: Fill 4 large cups with ice and pour in cold lemonade. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold. Keep a second round ready for the back half of the film.
